statement: A single-page website for the Spark 2026 college tech fest at Northfield College of Engineering, Pune (14 to 16 February 2027) where students can see the schedule by day, browse events by category, register for an event, see sponsors, find the venue and contact the organisers on WhatsApp.
audience: College students, mostly on phones, who want to find events, check timings and fees, and register.
standards: Energetic, modern look: bold colours, strong headings, consistent style
Mobile first: works well on phones and on desktop
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Photos shown as placeholders until real ones exist
Only facts supplied by the Requester appear as content
rules: Never invent facts: no building or hall name, no prizes, no logos, no extra events or sponsors
Show fees exactly as given (Rs amounts or Free)
Use the dates 14 to 16 February 2027 and the name Spark 2026 as given
Registration form submission goes to spark2026@example.com
done_when: The page shows the name Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, and the dates 14 to 16 February 2027

A schedule section lets visitors view Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3, each listing its events with the times given: Day 1 Code Sprint 10am-1pm, Line Follower 2pm-5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm-6:30pm; Day 2 Bug Hunt 11am-1pm, Poster Jam 2pm-4pm; Day 3 Drone Dash 10am-1pm, UI Duel 2pm-5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm-6:30pm

An events section lets visitors browse by the categories Coding, Robotics, Design and Talks, and every event shows its fee: Code Sprint Rs 100, Bug Hunt Rs 50, Line Follower Rs 150, Drone Dash Rs 200, Poster Jam free, UI Duel Rs 100, AI in Daily Life free, Startup Stories free
A registration form has the fields name, email, college and an event dropdown listing all 8 events, and its submission is directed to spark2026@example.com
A sponsors section lists Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs and Pixel Press by name, with no logos
A venue section shows Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007, with a map or a map link for that address
A WhatsApp link opens a chat with +91 00000 33333 and the email spark2026@example.com is shown as contact
Photo areas use clearly marked placeholders, and the page uses a bold, consistent, modern colour and type style
The layout has no horizontal overflow at 360px width and at 1280px width, and the navigation and form are usable on a phone-sized screen
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: See the schedule day by day
Register for an event with a form
